meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分诊问题与外部PR，生成可执行的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护开源项目，常被大量Issue和外部PR淹没，需要快速分诊归类。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an open-source project and need a fast way to sort incoming issues and external PRs.

howto.what: 把 issue 和外部 PR 推进分诊状态机:打分类与状态标签、核实报告、必要时逐条追问,产出可交给 agent 的简报;每条评论都带 AI 生成声明。
howto.when: 维护者输入 /triage 并用自然语言说明要做什么时接管,例如查看待处理项、分诊某个 issue 或 PR、移动 #42 的状态。

say.text: 看看有哪些 issue 和 PR 需要我处理
say.note: 按未标记、needs-triage 等三类列出
读全文与 diff,给出分类和状态建议
确认后直接应用角色,跳过追问

howto.what_en: Lets Claude move issues and external PRs through a triage state machine: apply one category and one state role, verify claims, grill one question at a time, and post agent-ready briefs. Every comment carries an AI-generated disclaimer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the maintainer invokes /triage and describes what they want in natural language — e.g. show what needs attention, triage a specific issue or PR, or move #42 to a new state.

say_en.text: Show me anything that needs my attention
say_en.note: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage and similar buckets
Reads the issue or PR and the diff, then recommends
Confirms, then applies the role directly
